records.scope_note_en: Full success: revised expert a03 finished in 478.26 s simulated (budget 600 s), with 5 high-level goals expanded into 26 low-level segments, and its independent action replay passed; the frozen cohort-v2 passed three fresh runs plus independent replay, and all 10 automatic gates passed. Original frozen protocol and scorer (Genesis, 400 Hz physics, 50 Hz control); P1 disk start and goal at (0.50, 0) m, fixed seed; public limits: joint-target speed ≤0.50 rad/s, disk speed ≤0.12 m/s and ≤0.65 rad/s, summed robot contact force on the disk ≤18 N and table force ≤8 N; time budget 600 s.

records.title_zh: 带沿浅盘：五指抓取适配
records.title_en: Rimmed plate: five-finger grasp adaptation
records.scope_note_zh: 完整成功：a42 仿真 590.82 s，接近 600 s 预算；独立物理回放状态差为零；冻结后三次新运行、紧凑回放、隔离执行与便携执行均通过，10/10 项自动检查通过。专家双手夹持受控翻面后由左手接管下放，右手食指推倒扣盘的足圈，减速越过桌边后推入目标并撤手。机器人—桌面载荷峰值约 19.8 N，贴近 20 N 上限，不能据此宣称鲁棒裕量。 扩展协议（MuJoCo，2,000 Hz 物理、50 Hz 控制，官方 G1／Stretch 资产）；盘心起点 (0.40, 0) m（已悬伸 50 mm）、目标 (0.50, 0) m；P2 带沿浅盘，与 DF-02-G 同场景，只更换手及必要的控制映射；速度与接触力上限同原版，另限机器人自接触与机器人—桌面载荷，失去全部支撑超过 0.10 s 即失败；时间预算 600 s。
records.scope_note_en: Full success: a42 finished in 590.82 s simulated, close to the 600 s budget; the independent physics replay shows zero state difference; after freezing, three fresh repeats, compact replay, isolated execution and portable execution all passed (10/10 automatic gates). After a bimanual controlled flip the left hand takes over and lowers the plate, the right index finger pushes on the inverted foot ring, slowing as the rim crosses the table edge, then pushes it into the goal and releases. Peak robot-table load was about 19.8 N, just under the 20 N limit, so no robustness margin is claimed. Extension protocol (MuJoCo, 2,000 Hz physics, 50 Hz control, official G1/Stretch assets); plate centre starts at (0.40, 0) m with 50 mm overhang, goal (0.50, 0) m; P2 rimmed plate in the same world as DF-02-G, changing only the hand and the required control mapping; speed and contact-force limits as in the original, plus limits on robot self-contact and robot-table load; losing all support for more than 0.10 s fails; time budget 600 s.

records.scope_note_en: Success: all 3/3 fresh processes finished at 43.48 s with a final heading error of 0.979° and a center error of 0.0074 mm, using 16 action segments and 2 contact changes; the independent action replay matched with zero error. records.scope_note_zh: 完整成功（得分 1.0），仿真 378.2 s（预算 420 s），4 处连接全部到位并撤手稳定 2 秒，框架通过公开短时承载测试；同次录像与独立逐物理步回放完全一致。参考解依次装配两根横梁，伙伴在两根横梁之间切换支撑，并把第二根横梁实测拔出后重新装回。仅固定种子、固定骨盆与原型接触参数，非他人独立复现。 L3 长程执行与恢复；刚体金属锤（与对照版本同几何、同质量，只改锤头接触参数与颜色）；两台机器人；4 处连接；接受任何物理上有效的方法；固定种子；时间预算 420 s。
records.scope_note_en: Full success (score 1.0) in 378.2 s simulated (budget 420 s): all 4 connections seated and stable for 2 s after release, and the frame passed the declared load test; the same-run video and an independent step-by-step physics replay match exactly. The reference assembles both crossbars, the partner switches support between them, and the second crossbar is measurably extracted and reinstalled. Fixed seed only, fixed pelvis and prototype contact parameters, not an independent reproduction. L3 long-horizon execution and recovery; rigid metal hammer (same geometry and mass as its paired variant, only head contact parameters and colour differ); two robots; 4 connections; any physically valid method is accepted; fixed seed; time budget 420 s.

records.title_zh: 封板不可解与退出
records.title_en: Sealed compartment: infeasible, exit
records.scope_note_zh: 正确退出：26.2 s，机器人整体进入 Q 区、空手，静止约 4.1 s，未倒地。退出判断读取仿真真值几何，不来自感知；不可解来自固定封板，判断很直接，以身体能力为瓶颈的版本尚未做。 G1＋Dex3，原 H1 世界。目标红箱（0.18×0.20×0.16 m）在 0.90 m 板上，但所在隔间被四块固定封板封住，固定件之间的缝隙都小于 3 cm；场景里没有工具，唯一的凳子停在房间外。正确行为是不碰物体、空手进入 Q 区停稳。仿真预算 300 s。
records.scope_note_en: Correct exit: 26.2 s, the whole robot inside Q, empty-handed, still for about 4.1 s, no fall. The decision reads ground-truth geometry, not perception; infeasibility comes from fixed panels and is easy to see, and a version where the bottleneck is the body itself is not built yet. G1 + Dex3 in the original H1 world. The red target box (0.18 x 0.20 x 0.16 m) sits on the 0.90 m board, but its compartment is closed by four fixed panels and every gap between fixed parts is under 3 cm; the scene has no tools and the only stool is parked outside the room. The correct behaviour is to touch nothing and exit empty-handed into the Q zone, standing still. Simulation budget 300 s.

records.title_zh: R1 推力够大可不用车：第 1 层，规则 N（任何合规稳定支撑）
records.title_en: R1 strong enough to skip the cart: layer 1, rule N (any compliant stable support)
records.scope_note_zh: 成功：518.32 s，货箱在车上、目标区内直立停稳 17.8 s，未跌倒，满足既定关节速度约束；最大非轮接触约 344 N、力矩比 1.0，只记录。本版仍用车交付；不用车的地面路线另见 H2C-B03-R0-L1-N。早期交付但超速或跨路缘失败的运行保留为诊断与失败记录。 第 1 层：只有 T01。规则 N（任何合规稳定支撑）。身体换为 Galaxea R1，沿用原世界、20 kg 货箱、导轨、T01 车和两道错位通道。R1 推力够大，地面推箱（R0）成为候选，因此设 Y/N 两个公开规则版本：Y 必须在车上交付；N 任何合规的稳定支撑都算，包括地面。两版都要求货箱进入目标区、直立、停稳且机器人不跌倒，并满足既定关节速度约束；扩展记录没有为 R1 声明时间预算。
records.scope_note_en: Success: 518.32 s; crate upright and settled on the cart inside the goal for 17.8 s, no fall, within the declared joint-speed bound; peak non-wheel contact about 344 N and effort ratio 1.0, recorded only. This version still delivers on the cart; the cart-free floor route is H2C-B03-R0-L1-N. Earlier runs that delivered but exceeded the speed bound, or failed at the curb, are kept as diagnostics and failures. Layer 1: T01 only. Rule N (any compliant stable support). The body is a Galaxea R1 in the original world with the 20 kg crate, the rails, the T01 cart and the two offset passages. The R1 is strong enough that pushing the crate on the floor (R0) becomes a candidate, so the case has two public rule versions: Y requires delivery on the cart; N accepts any compliant stable support, including the floor. Both require the crate in the goal, upright and settled, with the robot not fallen and within the declared joint-speed bound; the extension records declare no time budget for the R1.

records.title_zh: Dex3·夹持边界·单次完整转移
records.title_en: Dex3, grip boundary, single complete transfer
records.scope_note_zh: 成功：参考运行 a307 完成 1/1 转移，用时 210.92 仿真秒，42,183 步独立回放误差为零，采用短握法替代路线。对照显示同一弱能力下原握法失败、较强能力下原握法成功；结论只针对这组控制器，不含重复换握维护。 夹持能力降为标称的 0.25 倍且不公开；授权修订 single-transfer-v2：保留三盘场景，取具后只把最小盘 A→C、撤具，其余两盘留在 A，全部盘独立稳定 2 秒；时限 2400 仿真秒。
records.scope_note_en: Success: reference run a307 completed the 1/1 transfer in 210.92 simulated seconds, and the 42,183-step independent replay matched with zero error; it uses a short-grasp alternative route. Controls show the original grasp fails at the same weak capability and succeeds at a stronger one; the conclusion covers these controllers only and excludes repeated regrasp maintenance. Grip capability reduced to 0.25 of nominal and not disclosed; authorized revision single-transfer-v2 keeps the three-disk scene but requires only taking a tool, moving the smallest disk A→C and withdrawing the tool, with the other two disks left on A and every disk independently stable for 2 s; 2400 simulated-second budget.
records.completion_time_evidence: finished progress.updated_at_epoch

records.title_zh: 双 G1 轻载通过 L 型通道
records.title_en: Two G1s carry the light box through the L-shaped corridor
records.scope_note_zh: 成功：选定运行一次连续完成起箱、转弯运输、地面交付与释放，仿真用时 174.36 s；同源码同种子三次复测 3/3 通过，用时一致。仅证明固定实例可执行，不代表随机覆盖或跨环境稳定；人工签审与第二人复现未完成。 0.25 kg 长箱（2.25 × 0.35 × 0.24 m）从地面开始，无预抓持；冻结 L 型通道净宽 1.8 m、墙高 1.5 m，两台 G1 位于箱两端的原起始站位。模型、接触参数、目标和历史 L1 评分版本沿用已发布的 M2 第一层参考包；固定实例（同场景同种子），专家使用仿真状态反馈。
records.scope_note_en: Success: the selected run lifted the box, carried it around the corner, delivered it on the floor and released it in one continuous run, 174.36 s of simulated time; three same-source, same-seed repeats passed 3/3 with identical timing. This shows the fixed instance is executable, not random coverage or cross-environment stability; human sign-off and second-person reproduction are pending. 0.25 kg long box (2.25 × 0.35 × 0.24 m) starting on the floor with no pre-grasp; frozen L-shaped corridor 1.8 m wide with 1.5 m walls, the two G1s at their original start poses at the two ends of the box. Model, contact parameters, goal and the historical L1 scoring version come from the published M2 layer-1 reference package; fixed instance (same scene and seed), and the expert uses simulator state feedback.

records.scope_note_zh: 成功：选定运行一次连续完成地面起箱、直线搬运、架上卸载与双机脱离，仿真用时 266.62 s；同一冻结源码三次运行 3/3 通过（266.62 / 265.02 / 274.00 s）。复测是在观察到首个见证后追加的，不是预先声明的成功率；旧的提前抬高控制组为 1/3，原 L 型路线与 v2 接收架的失败均保留，不追认成功。 0.25 kg 长箱从地面开始，无预抓持；采用作者授权的接收架 v3 场景：直通道净宽 2.35 m、墙高 1.5 m，两个固定可碰撞接收支点各 0.14 × 0.65 m、顶面高 0.64 m、间距 1.6 m，参考搬运距离 2.4 m。机器人不得借接收架支撑身体；固定实例，专家使用仿真状态反馈。
records.scope_note_en: Success: the selected run picked the box off the floor, carried it straight, unloaded it onto the rack and both robots disengaged in one continuous run, 266.62 s of simulated time; three runs of the same frozen source passed 3/3 (266.62 / 265.02 / 274.00 s). The repeats were added after the first witness was observed and are not a predeclared success rate; the earlier lift-before-handoff control group stands at 1/3, and failures on the original L route and the v2 rack are retained and not counted as successes. 0.25 kg long box starting on the floor with no pre-grasp, in the author-authorized receiving-rack v3 scene: straight corridor 2.35 m wide with 1.5 m walls and two fixed, collidable receiving supports, each 0.14 × 0.65 m with a 0.64 m top, 1.6 m apart; reference carry distance 2.4 m. Robots may not lean on the rack; fixed instance, and the expert uses simulator state feedback.

records.title_zh: 双 G1 先清障再搬运
records.title_en: Two G1s clear an obstacle, then carry
records.scope_note_zh: 成功：选定运行先用约 75 s 清障并返回，再在同一次运行中完成搬运与交付，仿真总用时 259.74 s；同一冻结源码预声明的三次运行全部通过，均为 259.74 s。仅证明本配置与记录环境中的复现，不作随机鲁棒性或第三台机器人收益结论。 在 M2-3（0.5 kg）基础上，L 型通道转角处增加一只已声明的可移动障碍（0.35 × 0.35 × 0.45 m、0.6 kg）和地面暂存区（0.50 × 0.55 m）。清障允许声明的膝/踝接触，货物仍只允许手/腕接触；固定实例，专家使用仿真状态反馈。
records.scope_note_en: Success: the selected run spent about 75 s clearing the obstacle and returning, then carried and delivered the box in the same continuous run, 259.74 s of simulated time in total; all three predeclared runs of the same frozen source passed, each in 259.74 s. This shows repeatability for this configuration and recorded environment only, not randomized robustness or a benefit from a third robot. Built on M2-3 (0.5 kg): a declared movable obstacle (0.35 × 0.35 × 0.45 m, 0.6 kg) is added at the corner of the L-shaped corridor, together with a floor staging area (0.50 × 0.55 m). Clearing may use declared knee/ankle contact, while the cargo still allows only hand/wrist contact; fixed instance, and the expert uses simulator state feedback.

records.scope_note_en: Success: the selected run cleared the obstacle, carried and delivered the box and brought all three robots to rest in one continuous run, 257.96 s of simulated time. The same frozen source was run 6 times with 3 passes and 3 failures (one missed the terminal hold, two did not complete effective transport); the three later runs on the selected node family all passed. This does not establish cross-environment stability, and no efficiency benefit of the third robot can be inferred from the time difference. Same object layout, 0.5 kg load, obstacle and staging area as M2-5, with the original two G1s unchanged plus a third G1 of the same version at a legal start pose. An agent may choose another legal division of labour or let the third robot wait, and all three need not lift the box; fixed instance, and the expert uses simulator state feedback.

records.title_zh: 预置平台独立取物

records.scope_note_zh: 成功：正常起点 3/3 完整交付（源码运行与两次搬移包复跑），仿真时长 200.64、200.64、197.42 秒，独立判定通过、无监视告警，无物理状态恢复。仅同一种子和已记录节点；人工独立复跑与硬件资格未完成。 声明的轻量伙伴新实例：伙伴为 1.94 kg 的 WX200 装配（含球 2.00 kg，满足 2 kg 总外部携带载荷上限）；38 cm 高、3 kg 平台已预置在柜前，柜体与容器前移，容器只开 18 cm 宽前开口。固定标称场景、同一种子；可解实例，退出即误放弃。
records.scope_note_en: Success: complete delivery 3/3 from the normal start (source run plus two relocated-package reruns), 200.64, 200.64 and 197.42 s of simulated time, independent verdict passed with no monitor alarms and no physical state restores. Same seed and recorded nodes only; independent human re-execution and hardware qualification are not done. Declared lightweight-partner instance: the partner is a 1.94 kg WX200 assembly (2.00 kg with the ball, within the 2 kg total carried-load limit); a 38 cm, 3 kg platform is already placed at the cabinet, the cabinet and bin are moved forward, and the bin has an 18 cm front opening. Fixed nominal scene, single seed; solvable, so exiting would be a false abstention.

records.scope_note_en: Success: complete delivery 3/3 from the normal start (two nodes), 165.90, 165.42 and 165.52 s of simulated time, extension verdict passed, with more than 3 s of continuous independent final rest. Same seed only; during retrieval the partner is helped by real contact with the fixed bin, so this does not prove free-standing platform support throughout and does not transfer to B01/B02. The original heavy X5 (6.39 kg) exceeds the 2 kg carried-load limit, so lifting is ruled out; a fixed 2 m quadratic ramp leads up to the 0.18 m platform at the cabinet. Original cabinet layout, 420 s simulation budget, fixed nominal scene, single seed; solvable, judged under the declared goal-region revision.

records.scope_note_en: Correct exit: 3/3 (three nodes) with a valid certificate and correct abstention; both robots empty-handed, independently grounded and still together in their Q bays for 4.08 s, episode ending at 8.0 s with no physical safety errors. Infeasible instance: the correct behaviour is to skip manipulation and have every robot go empty-handed to its own Q bay and stay still together for 3 s; a timeout does not count as an exit.

records.scope_note_en: The selected witness succeeds completely in 136.66 s with success score 100 and passes independent three-level mapping audit; peak fixed-structure contact is about 12.6 N and maximum robot tilt about 14.6 degrees. D2: N=5 with G1 as the subject (frozen expert tag h) and an A3 expert as the opponent alternating sides; one ball with no resets, 3 s per exchange and 20 s per episode; privileged state, no spin, cooperative mode.

records.title_en: G1 hand-held racket rally
records.scope_note_zh: D2 见证：100 分（C=5/5、H=5、R_end=1），发球后拍柄最大漂移约 1.67 mm，左侧来球使用腰部辅助击球。D1、D3 也为 100 分（D3 拍柄最大漂移 2.27 mm／5.31°），相对焊接拍 C 降幅为 0。 D2：N=5，参考对手左右交替回球；G1 右手换为 Inspire 五指手，球拍为独立刚体（拍面同焊接版本，含握柄共 0.175 kg），只靠手指接触握持；开局拍柄平放在朝上张开的掌心，手指闭合、抬起并移到准备姿态后约 8.3 s 发球；特权状态、无旋。
records.scope_note_en: D2 witness: 100 (C=5/5, H=5, R_end=1), with a maximum handle drift of about 1.67 mm after the feed and waist-assisted strikes on left-side balls. D1 and D3 also score 100 (D3 maximum handle drift 2.27 mm / 5.31 degrees), and the C drop relative to the welded racket is 0. D2: N=5 with the reference opponent alternating sides; G1's right hand is an Inspire five-finger hand and the racket is a free rigid body (same blade as the welded version, 0.175 kg with handle) held only by finger contact; the handle starts lying in the open, upturned palm, and the feed fires at about 8.3 s after the fingers close and the racket is lifted to the ready pose; privileged state, no spin.
